title: Zoom Out to the Structure
hero_prompt: A fine antique engraving in the style of an old architectural draftsman: a tiny repaired joint at the lower left, ringed by a draughtsman's loupe, its lines pulling the eye outward and upward to reveal that the small detail was always part of a vast bridge-and-cathedral lattice filling the frame. Nested scales, delicate cross-hatching, precise ruled linework opening into grand structure, warm sepia ink on aged paper, a darker upper register.
icon_prompt: A bold high-contrast square emblem in pure black and white: a small solid square nested inside three progressively larger concentric frames, a draughtsman's loupe over the innermost point. Sharp geometric printmaking silhouette, no gradients.
